responsibility: Implements the main RTL instruction recognition and validation support that sits between generic RTL transforms and target-generated recognizers. This file checks asm operand legality, manages the grouped validate_change/apply_change machinery for safely mutating insns or MEM addresses and re-recognizing them, drives operand extraction and constraint preprocessing state, performs insn splitting, and defines several RTL pass objects that run split_all_insns at specific post-reload/scheduling pipeline points, along with per-target recognizer cache reinitialization.
same_name_distinction: Contains the implementation of RTL instruction recognition support declared in gcc/recog.h, including asm operand checking, validate_change/apply_change machinery, insn splitting passes, and target recognizer cache reinitialization; the header chiefly defines recognizer data structures and public interfaces used by this code and generated recognizers.
